column7: An operator-supplied non-secret input (audit anchor via --anchor or audit.offline_anchor_path, --tsa-roots, recovery-key --recipient, restore --input) naming a FIFO blocked in open(2) forever. They now open through secretenv.OpenRegularNamed/ReadRegularFile (O_NONBLOCK + fstat on the descriptor) and refuse a non-regular file with "<what> <path>: not a regular file"; a regular file and a symlink to one still work. Same fix for the server CA bundle, license file and SAML IdP metadata file (server TestServerOperatorFiles_*), the startup database check (internal/startup TestValidateDatabase_FIFORefusedWithoutBlocking) and the k8s-sync --config (internal/k8ssync TestLoadConfig_FIFORefusedWithoutBlocking). The AST guard TestSecretFileReadsGoThroughOpenRegular now covers these files. Found by FIFO-3 follow-up scan.
